title: Clarify messaging: she left after one date, tone is 'please come back' not apologetic

The tone must be sweet, hopeful, and sincere — centered on 'please come back 🥺' — without any framing of messing up, mistakes, or apologies. Remove any language that implies a longer relationship or wrongdoing.

we are making this to ask her to please come back with 🥺 emoji that's it
